elements.element: Governing law is the laws of the State of New York
elements.evidence: 28.1 "This Agreement is governed exclusively by the laws of the State of New York."

elements.element: Exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County
elements.evidence: 28.2 "The state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction"

elements.element: Governing law and forum form a permitted corresponding pair
elements.evidence: New York law paired with New York County state and federal courts

elements.element: Delaware or California law with the corresponding Delaware/California courts

offending_extra_words: temporary injunctive relief in those courts to protect
reasons: The preferred level is fully achieved: 28.1 now selects New York law and 28.2 already conferred exclusive jurisdiction on the state and federal courts in New York County, a permitted corresponding pair.
Operation 1 (striking the Singapore law and Singapore venue words and substituting New York law) is the minimal edit needed; nothing further was required.

Operation 2 is an unnecessary second edit to an untouched sentence: the interim-relief carve-out did not conflict with the preferred position, and rewriting "another court with jurisdiction" to "those courts" was not needed to complete the selected level.

That narrowing also degrades a mutual protection our own client relies on (the ability to seek emergency injunctive relief protecting Confidential Information or IP wherever assets or infringers are located) and leaves the sentence practically self-cancelling, since relief in the exclusive forum needs no carve-out.
Recommended fix: retain operation 1 only and leave 28.2's injunctive-relief sentence as drafted.
